answer: In this PoA network, reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained, verifiable honest service rather than a brief burst. EigenTrust matrix factorization propagates trust through weighted reciprocal attestations; a freshly spawned sybil therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus. A voyage across a shale horizon adds no influence unless it yields durable, independent support.
